title: Survey Medical Expert
summary:
This study focuses on the role of clinical experts providing judgment-based recommendations, particularly in areas where evidence is lacking.
It aims to explore how clinicians perceive these expert consensus recommendations: how they interpret them, how they use them in practice, and what they expect from the experts who produce them.
conditions: not related to any specific disease

interventions.name: Anonymised online survey from July 1,2026, - December 31, 2026

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Licensed medical professionals from all medical specialties
Exclusion criteria:
Medical students, non-physician health professionals
